text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy... That's a full-blown cold right there.
You'd better stay in bed for a while.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Mar-ve-choo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't need the cold version of that!
Just rest quietly already.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. Wonder if Marvelous
has been sleeping quietly~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where is—
...Wait, this is pretty normal for Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, no, this isn't normal at all!?
I-Isn't it kinda gloomy in here...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...My marvelous... has run dry.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Marvelous can run dry!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...When I'm lying in bed all alone, there are no surprises...
Just like when I was little and sickly...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And besides... when I woke up,
Nature, you weren't here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Sorry about that.
It's pretty lonely being sick, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll stay right by your side until you fall asleep this time.
So relax and rest up, and get rid of that cold quickly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like you're finally able to sit up normally.
How're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm okay.
...My marvelous isn't quite back yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Hey. You've been eating all your meals
alone in your room lately, right?
Wanna try eating outside for the first time in a while?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Is this a hamburg steak set meal?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You can't get your energy back on just rice porridge, right?
Don't worry, it's a special recipe made with your recovering body in mind.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... thank you.
Thanks for the food~—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...!? T-This flavor...!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: I-It's so sweeeet!?!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
T-That surprised me!
What's this, what's this!? What did you do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ma... Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... S-Surprise~! E-Even though it looks like
a hamburg steak, it's actually super sweet~...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well~ y'know. We wanted to cheer you up,
so me and some friends put our heads together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a hamburg steak, but it's actually a donut!
The miso soup's tofu is really agar jelly! And stuff like that...
Basically, we whipped up a surprise combo meal.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...How is it? Was it... marvelous enough?
Well, I doubt it holds a candle
to the kind of stuff you usually pull off, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...MARVELOUS☆!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Filled with all of your heartfelt feelings,
this is an utterly marvelous surprise☆!
My heart is just overflowing with it...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆! Marvelous to the ends of the earth★!
An eternal marvelous that will stay in my heart forever☆!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature, let's head out! To spread the word of this
marvelous! To discover brand new marvelousness☆★☆!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A full recovery celebration, huh... Alright!
Big sister Nature will tag along with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the whole series of marvelous events
was widely broadcast across the academy
by Marvelous Sunday herself.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I must engrave this marvelous deep into my soul!
Down the hatch, thanks for the food~☆!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, hey now, take your time and eat slowly.
I'm really happy you love it that much, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the whole series of marvelous events
was widely broadcast across the academy
by Marvelous Sunday herself.
